newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Mosaic sees gas shows in Surat Basin well.
newsitem.headline: Mosaic sees gas shows in Surat Basin well.

text.p: Mosaic Oil NL said on Tuesday it has encountered gas shows over two intervals in its onshore Downlands-2 gas appraisal well in the Surat Basin in Queensland.
Gas shows were encountered over a five-metre interval and an eight-metre interval in the well which has reached 1,882 metres, Mosaic said in a statement.
Strong flourescence was associated with the gas shows.
The well would be drilled another 20 metres into basement when a decision to drill stem test would be made, it said.
